description: Homelab policy: everything self-merges. Breaking changes are acceptable — Uptime Kuma is the smoke test. The ONE exception is the data layer (see the 'databases' rule below), where a bad major is painful to unwind.

No managerFilePatterns overrides here on purpose: Renovate MERGES those with its defaults rather than replacing them, so narrowing to apps/ and pico/ would have added nothing while implying a restriction that does not exist. The defaults already cover apps/*/Chart.yaml, apps/*/values.yaml, pico/*/compose.yaml, cilium/Chart.yaml, terraform/*.tf and .github/workflows/*.

ignoreTests is required, not optional: this repo has no CI on the Renovate branches, and GitHub reports a combined commit status of 'pending' when a branch has ZERO checks (not 'success'). Renovate will not automerge a non-green branch, so without this nothing self-merges — the first forced run opened 22 automergeable PRs and merged none of them. platformAutomerge also cannot arm here (GitHub rejects enabling auto-merge on an already-mergeable PR with no required checks), so Renovate merges directly instead.
Bare `image: repo:tag` lines inside chart TEMPLATES, which no built-in manager reads — currently busybox in apps/gym-booker/templates/deployment.yaml.

Scoped to templates/ only, deliberately. It used to cover apps/*/values.yaml too, but helm-values already models those (kubectl and distroless-iptables in apps/ttyd/values.yaml), so both managers found the same dep and Renovate opened two PRs for it — #23 renovate/apps-ttyd and #24 renovate/kubernetes-images.
1. DATA LAYER — never self-merge. A bad Postgres/MySQL/MariaDB major means a restore, not a rollback. These open a PR and wait for Steve.

Regex, not globs: depNames here are a mix of bare (`mysql`, `redis`, `cloudnative-pg`) and registry-qualified (`ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres`), and a `**mysql**` glob does not reliably match a name with no path separators. Substring regex matches both forms. Checked against the real dependency set — `phpmyadmin` does not collide.
2. Self-built images. Tagged with a git SHA or built by hand on pico — Renovate has no upstream to compare against and would only churn. The GitHub Actions that build them own their versioning.

Regex again — Renovate reports these fully qualified (`docker.io/stevegore/ttyd`, not `stevegore/ttyd`), so a `stevegore/**` glob anchored at the start would miss them. The bare names are images built on pico that exist in no registry at all.

packageRules.description: 3. Floating tags (:latest, :release, :buildx-stable-1). Nothing for Renovate to bump — these refresh when Portainer force-pulls on its redeploy cycle. Muted so they do not sit on the dashboard forever.
4. Kubernetes-adjacent images carry ordering constraints with the OKE control plane (currently v1.36.x). Group them so kubectl/iptables/etc. move together in one PR rather than racing each other.
5. Chart + image for the same app land together, so ArgoCD does one sync instead of two.
6. GitHub Actions: batch into one weekly PR — the workflows are not load-bearing enough to warrant individual PRs.
7. The caddy Dockerfile builds a custom binary. A base-image bump needs a manual buildx push + tag bump in values.yaml (see apps/caddy/Dockerfile), so it cannot self-merge.
prBodyNotes:
:warning: Merging this is **not** enough. Rebuild and push the image, then bump `image.tag` in `apps/caddy/values.yaml`:
```
docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 \
  -t syd.ocir.io/sdajdczqv0qo/caddy:<new-tag> --push apps/caddy/
```
